name: Flat vector minimal
one_line: Clean flat shapes, five colours and room to breathe.
look_words: A landscape built from flat, clean shapes like a travel poster. Layered hills in sage and teal, sand and cream for paths and buildings, a big pale sun, a sky with one gentle fade. No outlines, no texture, no shading beyond one lighter and one darker tone per shape. There is plenty of empty space, and everything lines up neatly. Orange and soft pink mark what to collect and where to go, vermilion is harm, and the player is dark navy. Shapes are geometric: circles, triangles for trees, long curves for roads. Motion is smooth and eased, with simple slides and scales. Avoid detail, noise, realistic light, drop shadows, glow and clutter.

palette.name: flat poster
palette.notes: High ambient light keeps shapes flat. Use fog to separate the layers of hills rather than detail.

upgrade.why: its clean toon style flattens an ordinary scene into tidy fills

music.mood: light, mellow electric piano and soft claps
